purpose: Part A: the replication configuration must match the recorded seed-0 H2 run in everything except the seed

recorded_seed0_config.hypothesis: H2: the matching pathway is untrainable because the soft-argmin is numerically saturated. Standardising the aggregated cost across the disparity axis immediately before the soft-argmin, and changing nothing else, should restore gradient flow to the feature extractor and aggregation.
recorded_seed0_config.control: EXP-H1-WORKING-v2 (already trained; not retrained for this experiment)
recorded_seed0_config.changed_variable: regression stage: DisparityRegression -> phase2.models.scaled_regression.StandardisedDisparityRegression (per-pixel z-score across the 12 candidates, eps=1e-5, applied to the upsampled cost the softmax consumes)
recorded_seed0_config.held_fixed: cost_volume_shift='left', feature extractor, cost volume, aggregation, refinement, loss, optimizer, schedule, seed, data split, crop, augmentation, epochs, batch size, precision -- the H1 recipe imported from phase2/scripts/exp_h1_cost_volume.py
recorded_seed0_config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
recorded_seed0_config.augmentation: random crop, independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip (it inverts disparity)
recorded_seed0_config.initialisation: PyTorch defaults, random, seed 0 -- identical to the H1 arms (the changed module holds no parameters)
recorded_seed0_config.validation_protocol: first 10 scenes of hailo_val, full 368x1232 frames, pooled over gt > 0, every 5 epochs (exp_h1_cost_volume.validate, imported)
recorded_seed0_config.primary_endpoint: fraction of training batches on which ||grad(feature_extractor)|| + ||grad(aggregation)|| (2-norm combined) exceeds 1e-12
recorded_seed0_config.known_limitation: one seed, 160 training scenes from random initialisation -- the same budget as both H1 arms. The comparison against EXP-H1-WORKING-v2 is a controlled A/B of the changed variable; neither arm's absolute accuracy is a ceiling.

replication_config.augmentation: random crop, per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1, no flip
replication_config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity

loss.seed0_record: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
loss.replication: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity

augmentation.seed0_record: random crop, independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip (it inverts disparity)
augmentation.replication: random crop, per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1, no flip

augmentation_note: the record's wording differs from this script's one-line summary; the augmentation itself is the same imported CroppedKitti (jitter 0.1, no flip)
